title: Ali aur Dadu – 3 Pyaari Islamic Kahaniyan | Salam, Cheenk, Sach | Islamic Cartoon for Kids
description:
Ali aur Dadu ki 3 pyaari Islamic kahaniyan ek saath! 🌙 Bachchon ke saath dekhein aur achhi aadatein sikhayein. 🤲

00:00 Shuruaat
00:03 Kahani 1: Ali aur Salam
01:10 Kahani 2: Ali ko Cheenk Aayi
02:17 Kahani 3: Ali ne Sach Bola

📖 Kahani 1 – Salam:
Abu Hurairah (RA): Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, "Aapas mein Salam phailao." — Sahih Muslim 54 (Sahih)
"Jab tumhein Salam kiya jaye to usse behtar jawab do, ya wahi lauta do." — Surah An-Nisa 4:86

📖 Kahani 2 – Cheenk:
Abu Hurairah (RA): Cheenk aaye to "Alhamdulillah", sunne wala kahe "Yarhamukallah", jawab "Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu baalakum." — Sahih Bukhari 6224 (Sahih)

📖 Kahani 3 – Sach:
Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (RA): Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya, "Sach neki ki taraf le jaata hai, aur neki Jannat ki taraf le jaati hai." — Sahih Bukhari 6094, Sahih Muslim 2607 (Sahih)

Roz nayi kahani — Hidayah ko subscribe karein ❤️
